title: QuickBooks settings appear under Integrations when the Integrations sub-toggle is ON
custom_preconds: 1. Log in as an Administrator with Settings > Integrations ON.
custom_steps:
1. Open the Settings area.
  2. Find the Integrations pages.
  3. Look for QuickBooks.
  4. Open it and confirm the QuickBooks configuration page loads.
custom_expected:
QuickBooks is shown under Integrations (alongside IBS and Open API).

The QuickBooks page loads (connection status, sync settings, mappings).

Build finding: the live build keeps QuickBooks under the Integrations settings (gated by the Integrations sub-toggle) — the 'move QuickBooks to Finance / remove Integrations' premise is not in the build and is stale versus the current spec.
viu_status: Deviation-vs-old-case: build has QuickBooks under Integrations, not Finance
evidence: Route metadata: Integrations gates IBS/Open API/QuickBooks; Finance gates Payment Methods/Taxes (no QuickBooks). QuickBooks is under Integrations in the build.
